questions.q: In which comic did Thor debut in August 1962?
questions.why: Journey into Mystery #83 (August 1962) featured Thor's first appearance.

questions.q: In early comics, what mortal identity does Thor live under on Earth?
questions.why: Odin sent Thor to Earth as the doctor Donald Blake, whose walking stick turns into Mjolnir.

questions.q: What item does Thor wear that doubles his strength but drains his energy?
questions.why: The enchanted belt multiplies his strength twofold, yet the energy it costs him makes him use it rarely.

questions.q: Who became the new Thor in the 2014 storyline following Original Sin?
questions.why: Jane Foster took up Mjolnir and became the Mighty Thor in 2014.

questions.q: Who is Thor's adoptive brother and long-time rival?
questions.why: Loki is Odin's adopted son and Thor's longtime nemesis.

questions.q: Which actor plays Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.why: Chris Hemsworth has played Thor since the 2011 film Thor.

questions.q: Which alien hero was given the hammer Stormbreaker by Odin after proving worthy?
questions.why: Beta Ray Bill earned Stormbreaker from Odin after proving himself worthy.

questions.q: In which year did Thor #159 reveal that Thor's mortal identity was a fabrication?
questions.why: Thor #159, published in 1968, revealed that Blake was a persona created for Thor.

questions.q: Who wrote the 2012 series Thor: God of Thunder?
questions.why: Jason Aaron and artist Esad Ribic launched Thor: God of Thunder in 2012.

questions.q: Which writer, Stan Lee's younger brother, scripted Thor's 1962 debut?
questions.why: Larry Lieber scripted Thor's debut, working with Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
